_note: Thai private car plates. Draw the ROI around the REGISTRATION ROW ONLY - the two Thai consonants and the number - and leave the province name underneath outside the box; it is a second line of text and it will wreck a single-line read. Format is one optional leading digit, one or two Thai consonants, then 1 to 4 digits with no leading zeros: 'กข 1234' and '1กข 1234' are both valid, which is what the pattern allows. min_chars is 3 because 'กข 1' is a legal plate. No "whitelist" is set on purpose: lang 'tha+eng' selects the Thai consonant alphabet automatically. Needs the Thai language pack - 'sudo apt install tesseract-ocr-tha' on Debian and Raspberry Pi OS - or engine 'easyocr', which downloads its own Thai model on first use. Motorcycle plates put the series, the province and the number on three separate rows: draw a separate ROI for the top and bottom rows rather than one box around both.
